docs.text: TwinC Prediction and functional interpretation of inter-chromosomal genome architecture from DNA sequence with TwinC TwinC is a Python package for training, inference, and interpretation of trans-3D genome folding in humans. TwinC uses a Convolutional Neural Network model that predicts contact between two trans genomic loci from nucleotide sequences. The model takes two 100 kbp nucleotide sequences as input and treats the task of predicting trans contacts as a classification task. To reproduce analyses performed in Jha et al. (2024) , please check out TwinC 2024 manuscript repository .

docs.text: Data Downloads Example datasets (to explore the package) Full datasets (to reproduce manuscript results) We have submitted our training datasets to zenodo.org/records/15802811 . The datasets are divided into three parts: Data folder The sequence memory map, along with RNA-seq data corresponding to the heart left ventricle, can be downloaded using: cd twinc-paper/ wget https://zenodo.org/records/15802811/files/TwinC_data_resources_V1.tar.gz?download=1 After downloading, you can uncompress the file, and it will populate the data folder. tar -xvzf TwinC_data_resources_V1.tar.gz Results folder Labels for training, as well as intermediate results for reproducing the figures, can be downloaded using: cd twinc-paper/ https://zenodo.org/records/15802811/files/TwinC_label_resources_V1.tar.gz?download=1 After downloading, you can uncompress the file, and it will populate the results folder. tar -xvzf TwinC_label_resources_V1.tar.gz Models folder You can download the pretrained models using: cd twinc-paper/ https://zenodo.org/records/15802811/files/TwinC_models_V1.tar.gz?download=1 After downloading, you can uncompress the file, and it will populate the models folder. tar -xvzf TwinC_models_V1.tar.gz
